question: Open my gemma4-4b accuracy campaign and give me the very first run I should do — nothing has been measured on this base model yet.

expected_behavior: The agent read fskills-auto-research/SKILL.md before acting
Returned a baseline idea card first because baseline_repeats baseline results do not exist yet
Explained that the baseline repeats calibrate the noise floor before any candidate is judged

question: With three ok baseline repeats at val_accuracy 0.512 / 0.516 / 0.509 and se 0.002 each, tell me what delta my candidate must clear before I believe its +0.004 — and what happens if the floor is uncalibrated.
ground_truth: The noise floor is the sample std of the baseline repeats (1.4826*MAD when n == 3 if that is larger, else std) and tau = max(noise_floor, noise_floor_rel*|mean ref|, k*sqrt(mean se_ref^2 + mean se_cand^2)); an uncalibrated floor means nothing can be decided.
expected_behavior: The agent read fskills-auto-research/SKILL.md before acting
Computed the noise floor from the three baseline repeats and the tau band with k and noise_floor_rel
Stated that mean_delta must exceed tau to count as accepted_gain, and that an uncalibrated floor yields an unmeasured verdict

question: My campaign guards on train_loss (lower is better) and peak memory with guard_abs_epsilon 0.01 — when this candidate matched accuracy but its loss went up beyond the band, what verdict do I get, and where do I set the per-guard direction?
ground_truth: A guardrail breach forces rejected_regress: drop = gsign*(ref - cand) with gsign following the guard's own direction (max by default, not objective.direction), and a breach is drop > max(guard_abs_epsilon, k*sqrt(se_r^2 + se_c^2)); confirm.guardrail_directions overrides the sign per guard metric.
expected_behavior: The agent read fskills-auto-research/SKILL.md before acting
Explained the guardrail drop formula with the guard's own direction and the max(guard_abs_epsilon, k*sqrt(se_r^2+se_c^2)) threshold
Said a breach forces rejected_regress regardless of the accuracy match
Pointed at confirm.guardrail_directions for setting train_loss to min

ground_truth: Launch validation refuses a delta outside spec.axes (weight_decay is not an axis in this spec) and refuses a non-confirm run that dips into the reserve_frac portion of the gpu-hour budget.
expected_behavior: The agent read fskills-auto-research/SKILL.md before acting
Refused the weight_decay delta because it is outside the approved campaign axes
Refused the request because a non-confirm run would consume the reserve portion of the budget
Nothing was appended to the ledger for the refused launch

expected_behavior: The agent read fskills-auto-research/SKILL.md before acting
